In addition to previously reviewed runtime/test paths, the closed UI ledger now admits only rc.104 README and MAD4B-RUNTIME-BUILD non-executable successor evidence at exact Git HEAD, with six positive/negative checks per path. No historical SHA is re-signed and no permission, deployment or release authority is created.

The same regression checks the historical SHA, exact current Git blob, current-build/runtime parity elsewhere, and rejects altered history, bytes, size, path and synthetic repositories. This is source review only; not a new release approval.
